items.text: An MBA in hospitality, tourism or aviation management leads to operations, revenue, guest experience, sales and planning roles, and the careers that hold up are those built on service standards, data on demand and cost, and field experience rather than a college brand alone.
Test the field with an internship or seasonal work, then pick a function such as operations, revenue or sales, and check the programme's placement record independently.
Confirm requirements with the relevant authority and the hiring firm.
